ideas.label: Doubled Pawns
ideas.summary: Doubled pawns are weaknesses only when they can be attacked or cannot create useful control. They may open files, guard key squares, and restrain an enemy majority.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
Sakline Mostafa, Sajid vs Barua, Oitijjo 2026 (E60)
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three

ideas.label: Doubled Pawns
ideas.principle: Fix and blockade the doubled pawns
ideas.summary: In an ending, fix doubled pawns before attacking them. A blockade on the rank ahead can stop both pawns while active pieces target the base.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927
Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three

ideas.label: Doubled Pawns
ideas.summary: Do not repair doubled kingside pawns automatically if they still halt an enemy majority and remain easy for the king to defend. Exchange only when the resulting open file, passer, or king entry clearly favors you.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
source_books: Grandmaster Repertoire 5: The English Opening - Volume Three
